sources.measurement_method: ArcGIS point-intersection query at OSM building center; returned WGS84 polygon independently projected using the repository local approximation; source SHAPE__Area is Web Mercator and is retained separately
sources.comparison: Selected as the primary exterior massing outline. Dated 2018 orthophoto overlay shows it tracing the same roof as OSM; state polygon is larger, and roof-versus-wall edge/georegistration residual is unresolved. sources.uncertainty: LiDAR-derived generalization, not cadastral survey. Orthophoto overlay does not resolve exact wall line versus roof edge; county metadata reports +/-2.5 ft horizontal accuracy at 90% for county aerial imagery.

footprint_resolution: State Indiana 2018 LiDAR footprint feature 443017 is selected as primary exterior massing outline after overlay against dated 2018 orthophoto. OSM way 116427223 is identity/location corroboration only. Both outline the same roof; exact roof edge versus wall line remains unresolved. 1,908 sq ft is likely secondary-reported floor area, not parcel area; official assessor card unavailable.
area_interpretation: State ring 2,784 sq ft projected ground area; OSM ring 2,252 sq ft; LoopNet 1,908 sq ft with secondary aggregator labeling it first-floor/gross area. Do not treat these as directly comparable or claim a verified footprint area.
